name: Harukanaru Toki no Naka de 3: Unmei no Labyrinth
original_name: 遙かなる時空の中で３　運命の迷宮
source:
The Genpei War ends with a peace treaty, and the main characters have defeated an arcane evil within the modern world. The protagonist's winter break can still be celebrated through the power of time traveling. Yet she begins to experience sudden memory loss, and Hakuryu is too weak to return to the parallel world due to a magically erected labyrinth. Wishing to restore everything and everyone to their proper form, the protagonist and her comrades seek to unravel the maze's secrets.

[from [url=http://koei.wikia.com/wiki/Harukanaru_Toki_no_Naka_de_3_Unmei_no_Labyrinth]Koei Wikia[/url]]
translation:
源平戰爭以和平條約告終，主要角色也在現代世界擊敗了神秘的邪惡力量。藉助穿越時空的能力，主角仍能歡度寒假。然而，她開始突然失去記憶，而一座由魔法形成的迷宮令白龍虛弱得無法返回平行世界。為了讓大家和一切事物恢復原狀，主角與同伴開始探尋迷宮的秘密。

[摘自[url=http://koei.wikia.com/wiki/Harukanaru_Toki_no_Naka_de_3_Unmei_no_Labyrinth]Koei Wikia[/url]]
